modules.name: Optics
modules.description: Optics and photonics: light and photons, geometric optics, diffraction, Gaussian beams, cavities and etalons, fibers, frequency combs, detection and materials, with the optics tools and material data. Version 1.1 adds formulas following Saleh & Teich’s Fundamentals of Photonics (rays to ultrafast optics) and Neamen’s Semiconductor Physics and Devices (carriers, junctions, transistors, optical devices). Every formula solves for any of its variables.

modules.name: Machinist
modules.description: Shop tools for machinists: speeds and feeds, thread pitch and tap drills, number, letter, fractional and metric drills with their metric and inch sizes, clearance holes, shop calculators, and a G-code and M-code reference.
